title: The Borel complexity of conjugacy for Cantor minimal systems
summary: We prove that conjugacy of minimal homeomorphisms of the Cantor space is Borel bireducible with isomorphism of countable graphs, answering the Cantor minimal case of a question of Foreman. We obtain the lower bound by encoding countably based profinite groups. Finite quotient homomorphisms are represented by factor maps between a common family of minimal subshifts. Amalgamation makes the resulting inverse limit independent, up to conjugacy, of the quotient presentation. Conversely, finite-stage factorization recovers the group from any conjugacy of these inverse limits.
